description: This file defines classes and methods for integrating Composio applications with a toolset, including loading apps, actions, and connections, and initializing tools with proper credentials and app info.

classes.name: ComposioTool
classes.description: Represents a tool for interacting with a specific Composio application, capable of executing actions.

classes.name: Composio_Tools
classes.description: Implements INode; manages loading, initializing, and interacting with Composio applications, including app, action, and connection management.

methods.name: loadMethods.listApps
methods.description: Loads list of available Composio apps using API credentials.

methods.name: loadMethods.listActions
methods.description: Loads list of actions for a selected app.

methods.name: loadMethods.listConnections
methods.description: Loads list of active connections for a selected app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, loads tools based on credentials, app info, and connection status.
